analysis.rationale: Multi-step deterministic degradation. Signals: sigma=0.37 -> NO noise; block_boundary=1.002 and every JPEG sim inflated block_boundary >190% -> NO jpeg; gm_ratio=0.138 + spectral_slope_ratio=1.404 + anisotropy=1.50 (<1.7, motion excluded) -> strong gaussian blur (lens tie, glass_score 0.304 marginal); variance_ratio=0.188 + mean_shift=-22.6 + chroma_ratio=0.505 -> contrast_weaken_stretch (preserves the target's 0.453% pure-black pixels; contrast_weaken_scale lifts all blacks and capped at 26.9dB) + saturation weaken. Severity scan on pair0 brackets stretch sev4 (26.49/29.92/32.69/34.29/27.51 for sev1..5). k=3 validation: 34.29 / 28.14 / 36.14 dB. UNCERTAIN because deterministic PSNR is 30-40dB (not >40) and blur severity 3-5 is PSNR-insensitive.
